Integrate streamlines and streamtubes through a vector field

Source: R/stats-streamline.R
stat_streamline_3d.Rd

A complete rectilinear x/y/z grid supplies u/v/w components. Trilinear interpolation and integration run in C++. Integration solves dp/dt = v(p) in transformed coordinate units; supply components in those units when using nonlinear position scales. Missing field cells stop a streamline.

Usage

stat_streamline_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  geom = c("path", "tube"),
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  seeds = NULL,
  n = 6L,
  step = 0.05,
  method = c("rk4", "rk45"),
  max_steps = 1000L,
  direction = c("both", "forward", "backward"),
  tolerance = 1e-05,
  max_lines = 200L,
  radius = NULL,
  sides = 12L,
  cap = "round",
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mapping, data, position, ..., na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

Standard layer arguments.

geom

"path" for lines or "tube" for rotation-minimising streamtubes.

seeds

Numeric x/y/z rows in original position units; a list with from, to, n for a line rake; or a list with plane ("xy", "xz", "yz"), at and n for a plane. NULL seeds a yz plane at the x midpoint. list(type = "even", plane = "xy", at = ..., spacing = ..., dtest = ...) uses Jobard-Lefer placement of streamlines of the projected field in each slice. The normal component is zero in this mode. Candidate seeds are spacing from accepted curves; tracing stops within dtest (default half the spacing). Sampling steps stay below half dtest.

n

Samples along a rake or each plane axis; one or two integers.

step

Maximum integration time step, default 0.05.

method

Fixed-step "rk4" or adaptive Dormand-Prince "rk45".

max_steps

Maximum accepted steps in each direction from a seed.

direction

"both", "forward" or "backward".

tolerance

RK45 local error tolerance relative to each axis span.

max_lines

Maximum curves per plane or explicit seed collection.

radius, sides, cap

Passed to geom_tube_3d()'s sweep machinery.

Value

A ggplot2 layer with computed norm, step, arclength, time and group. Streamtubes retain face means of these variables.

References

Dormand and Prince (1980), A family of embedded Runge-Kutta formulae. Jobard and Lefer (1997), Creating evenly-spaced streamlines of arbitrary density, doi:10.1007/978-3-7091-6876-9_5 .

Examples

d <- expand.grid(x = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 5),
                 y = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 5), z = c(-1, 1))
d$u <- -d$y; d$v <- d$x; d$w <- 0.15
ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z, u = u, v = v, w = w,
                               colour = ggplot2::after_stat(norm))) +
  stat_streamline_3d(seeds = rbind(c(0.6, 0, -0.8)), max_steps = 80) + coord_3d()
